text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect speech verb introducing direct quoted address
words.root_gloss_range: saying, uttering, attributed speech, public statement, and speech that can be received or disputed; local form selects the direct act of saying

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the quoted speech immediately opened by the reporting verb
final clarity qualifier that answers the opened speech act
adjacent opening sequence joining the speech verb to the vocative address

words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens the ayah as a completed speech act, moving the commission of 71:1 into Nuh's performed address. Its subject is not named again; the perfect 3ms verb and the following first-person declaration make the speaker recoverable, so the quoted warning rather than a repeated name carries the focus. The q-w-l field keeps this from being private intention: the warning becomes an accountable public utterance with speaker, audience, reception, and liability. Structurally the verb changes narration into direct encounter, and the formula known from 11:25 is heard here as Nuh's own opening speech. The later same-surah speech turns at 71:5, 71:10, 71:21, 71:23, and 71:26 make this first {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) the surah's initial speech hinge. Even the adjacent sound of {{ar:قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ}} ({{tr:qāla yā-qawmi}}) binds the speech launch to the people addressed.

topics.headline: implicit subject keeps the address moving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Nuh move from commissioned figure to speaking agent without the ayah pausing to repeat his name.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) as 3ms perfect, and attachment evidence identifies an implicit masculine singular speaker recoverable from the quoted first-person clause.

topics.headline: perfect verb turns commission into performed speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warning enter as enacted speech, not as a summary of doctrine or a still-pending assignment.
topics.reason: The verb is the reporting head of the quoted complement, so the prior mission is locally realized as direct utterance.

topics.headline: speech root makes the warning a public claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is voiced as a receivable and disputable statement, while the local verb still simply means he said.
topics.reason: The q-w-l lexical field supports public utterance pressure, but local grammar selects the Form I reporting verb rather than a nominal claim about speech.

topics.headline: speech opens warning, people, and clarity networks
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first verb already aiming toward people-address, warning, and clarity, with 11:25 confirming the Noah warning formula.
topics.reason: The local quote runs from {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) into {{ar:يَٰقَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yā-qawmi}}) and then to {{ar:نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun mubīnun}}); the supplied inter-ayah evidence gives 11:25 for the matching Noah formula.

topics.headline: first speech hinge begins the surah's reported-speech chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track 71:2 as the first public-address speech hinge before later reported speech turns at 71:5, 71:10, 71:21, 71:23, and 71:26.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah references, and nothing in the guardrails blocks treating them as a discourse-chain payoff.

topics.headline: adjacent q-sounds bind saying to people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the speech launch and the addressed collective as one compact opening movement.
topics.reason: The adjacent forms {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) and {{ar:قَوْمِ}} ({{tr:qawmi}}) visibly and audibly share the q-opening.

words.gloss_range: vocative particle that summons the addressee and opens the direct-address beat

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the directly governed addressee of the vocative particle
fused vocative address formed by the call particle and people noun

words.prose: {{ar:يَٰ}} ({{tr:yā}}) is the hinge from reported speech into summons. Before the warning role is named, the particle selects {{ar:قَوْمِ}} ({{tr:qawmi}}) as a directly addressed audience, so the speech begins as relation rather than detached information. Its call can hold both nearness and distance: the people are addressed face to face, yet they still have to be reached by the warning. The compact written form still carries the long vocative call, and recitation binds that open call-vowel to the following noun, letting the listener hear the opening as {{ar:يَٰقَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yā-qawmi}}), a fused address before the emphatic claim begins.

topics.headline: vocative particle selects the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning first summons its audience instead of beginning as abstract information.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:يَٰ}} ({{tr:yā}}) as a vocative particle, and attachment evidence forces its relation to {{ar:قَوْمِ}} ({{tr:qawmi}}).

topics.headline: summons carries contact and distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels both direct address and the distance that speech must cross, while the particle remains a simple local vocative.
topics.reason: The near/distant value is plausible as vocative pressure, but local syntax does not require choosing a special distance sense over ordinary direct address.

topics.headline: written and recited form fuses call to addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees and hears call and addressee arrive as one compact address unit.
topics.reason: The particle is orthographically and syntactically tied to the following vocative noun in the local word table and attachment evidence.

topics.headline: the particle pivots narration into encounter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the narration turn into face-to-face address before Nuh states his warning role.
topics.reason: The quoted complement starts after {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}), and {{ar:يَٰ}} ({{tr:yā}}) is the first element inside that quoted address.

words.gloss_range: vocative construct noun, my people, with elided first-person possessive carried by kasra
words.root_gloss_range: people, standing collective, established body, uprightness and correction fields; local noun selects the addressed social body, with standing imagery only as narrowed pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: vocative particle governing the addressed people
variant contrast that loosens the possessive vocative force of the local reading
same-surah later possessive form cited by surviving topic evidence as reported object of calling

words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمِ}} ({{tr:qawmi}}) names the audience as Nuh's own people, not a faceless public. The kasra preserves an elided first-person possessive, so possession and intimacy are carried by the noun's form rather than by a full written suffix. That matters against the variant pressure of {{ar:قَوْمُ}} ({{tr:qawmu}}): the local reading keeps the address inside speaker responsibility and grief, while the variant shows how different a less possessive address could feel. The q-w-m root can press the image of a standing social body, but here that pressure is narrowed to communal posture rather than imported as an independent uprightness claim. The word also receives the boundary handoff from the your-people commission in 71:1 and anticipates the reported object {{ar:قَوْمِى}} ({{tr:qawmī}}) in 71:5, so the same collective moves from assigned target to direct addressee to the later object of Nuh's day-and-night calling labor.

topics.headline: elided possessive makes the people Nuh's own
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is spoken from within a claimed communal bond, with my people compressed into the case-marked form.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence both identify the word as a vocative noun with elided first-person possessive yāʾ carried by kasra.

topics.headline: variant contrast highlights possessive intimacy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that case and reading choice affect the emotional closeness of the address, while the local reading remains the possessive vocative.
topics.reason: The accepted local parse is {{ar:قَوْمِ}} ({{tr:qawmi}}) with elided possessive; the {{ar:قَوْمُ}} ({{tr:qawmu}}) contrast is useful as variant pressure but does not govern the local parse.

topics.headline: people as a standing communal body
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warning address a shared communal posture, not only separate private individuals.
topics.reason: The q-w-m root family supports standing and establishment imagery, while local morphology selects the noun for people or folk rather than a verb of standing.

topics.headline: uprightness and correction color the address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel a corrective pressure on the collective's stance, without turning the noun itself into a command to stand straight.
topics.reason: V4 shows uprightness and correction branches in the root family, but the local surface is the people noun, so the payoff remains root pressure only.

topics.headline: the people thread crosses commission and address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same collective from 71:1 into 71:2 and 71:5 as the target, addressee, and reported object of Nuh's labor.
topics.reason: The supplied rows give concrete same-surah links: {{ar:قَوْمَكَ}} ({{tr:qawmaka}}) in 71:1, {{ar:قَوْمِ}} ({{tr:qawmi}}) in 71:2, and {{ar:قَوْمِى}} ({{tr:qawmī}}) in 71:5.

topics.headline: address relation precedes role assertion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Nuh speak as someone already inside the communal relation before he names his authority as warner.
topics.reason: The vocative phrase precedes {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}), so the quoted address establishes audience relation before predication.

topics.headline: cross-surah Noah formula becomes intimate address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a known Noah warning pattern from 11:25, but here it is specialized as intimate public address.
topics.reason: The rows supply 11:25 and 71:5 as concrete references for the people-warning and speech-address recurrence.

topics.headline: assigned people become my people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the commission delegated in 71:1 become personally owned in 71:2 through a shift from your people to my people.
topics.reason: The convergence row correctly gathers the local possessive morphology, variant pressure, and 71:1 boundary handoff without contradicting the guardrail parse.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle plus first-person suffix, opening the nominal role assertion

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: predicate of the emphatic first-person clause
preceding vocative phrase that sets audience relation before self-identification

words.prose: {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}) fuses emphasis with the speaker himself. The doubled n and attached first-person yāʾ compress assertion and person into one word. The attached first-person pronoun is the governed noun of the emphatic particle, and {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) is its predicate, so the clause does not begin with a command or accusation; it begins with accountable self-identification. After {{ar:يَٰقَوْمِ}} ({{tr:yā-qawmi}}), the word pivots from audience relation to speaker responsibility. The narration has just said he spoke, but inside the quote the sent figure says I, making the warning heard from the one who bears it. The n-sound link from {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}) toward {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) gives that grammatical link an audible thread.

topics.headline: emphasis and first person fuse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warning begin as solemn self-identification, not as an immediate command or accusation.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}) as an emphatic particle plus first-person pronoun opening the nominal sentence.

topics.headline: speaker bears the predicate role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speaker grammatically carry the warning role as identity, rather than watching warning appear as a detached action.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the suffix as the governed ism of {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) and {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) as the predicate.

topics.headline: one word compresses assertion and person
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees confirmation and personal responsibility arrive together before the addressee-bound phrase.
topics.reason: The surface combines the emphatic particle and attached first-person pronoun in one written word.

topics.headline: reported figure speaks as I
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the shift from narration about Nuh to Nuh's own first-person bearing of the warning.
topics.reason: The quoted clause resolves the speaker of {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) through the first-person suffix in {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}).

topics.headline: after vocative, self-responsibility begins
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah move from my people to I am for you, making relation precede role.
topics.reason: {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}) follows the vocative phrase and begins the inner nominal assertion.

topics.headline: nasal sound links assertion to warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the emphatic self-reference and the warning noun tied by a small repeated n-sound.
topics.reason: {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}) and {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) are close in the clause and share audible n-material.

words.gloss_range: fronted lām phrase with second-person plural suffix, for you or concerning you, routing the predicate toward the addressees

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the vocative group resumed by the second-person plural suffix
predicate whose role is routed through the fronted prepositional complement

words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) carries the summoned people forward as the second-person plural recipients of the warning role. Because it precedes {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}), the clause makes the audience relation land before the role noun itself: Nuh is encountered as for you before he is named as a warner. The lām relation is narrowed by context to an addressed recipient phrase, but in a warning clause it keeps both advantage and liability in view; the notice is for them, and it also becomes evidence concerning them. Its bound written form joins relation and addressee, so the audience is not repeated as a full noun but remains grammatically present inside the predicate.

topics.headline: suffix carries the addressed people forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the same people from vocative address into the recipient slot of the warning role.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the second-person plural suffix as addressed to the vocative group.

topics.headline: fronted phrase routes the predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears audience-directedness before the warning noun, so the role is not generic but aimed at these addressees.
topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) as lām plus 2mp pronoun, and attachment evidence treats it as a fronted complement of {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}).

topics.headline: for you carries advantage and exposure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning is for their benefit while also becoming a responsibility placed before them.
topics.reason: The local lām phrase licenses recipient-directed relation; broader liability force survives as contextual pressure because the predicate is a warning role, not a neutral benefit statement.

topics.headline: relation and addressee fuse in one word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the addressees carried forward inside a compact bound phrase rather than by repeating the full people noun.
topics.reason: The written form joins lām and the 2mp suffix in one word.

topics.headline: the warning role is specifically toward this audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands Nuh's role here as addressed toward this community, not as a detached self-description.
topics.reason: The prepositional complement is syntactically attached to the predicate {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}), restricting the role to the addressed people.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative predicate meaning a warner, with the warning-notice sense still close because the form can overlap agent and notice
words.root_gloss_range: warning, giving advance notice of danger, binding notice, vow or obligation; local context selects the warner or warning-notice branch, with vow-binding pressure narrowed

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: emphatic first-person clause whose predicate is the warning role
fronted audience complement routing the warning role
qualifying adjective making the warning clear

words.prose: {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) is the predicate of {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}), so warning becomes Nuh's role-identity rather than a one-time finite action. Its indefinite nominative form presents a function, not a fixed honorific title, and the prior imperative in 71:1 now appears embodied as the speaker's role in 71:2. The word can name the warner and keep the warning-notice sense close; the local first-person clause selects Nuh as warner, while the punishment horizon of 71:1 keeps formal advance notice before consequence in view. The n-dh-r family also touches vow and binding speech, narrowed here into the way notice makes the addressees responsible before outcome. Because {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) precedes it, the role is grammatically for this audience. Because {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) agrees with it, warning and clarity become one predicate pair, echoed in the Noah formula at 11:25 and answering the later warner question of 67:8.

topics.headline: warning becomes role identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command of 71:1 become who Nuh is for the people in 71:2.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) as the predicate of {{ar:إِنِّى}} ({{tr:innī}}), and QAC marks it as indefinite nominative.

topics.headline: indefinite form presents function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a live operative warning function, not a settled title detached from the speech scene.
topics.reason: The tanwīn and nominative predicate shape support an indefinite role-quality reading.

topics.headline: warner and warning-notice overlap
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the messenger and the notice converge in one role noun, while local grammar still identifies Nuh as the warner.
topics.reason: QAC explicitly notes that the form can denote agent or warning itself; the first-person predicate selects the agent role while preserving notice pressure.

topics.headline: advance notice before consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears warning as formal advance notice before the painful punishment horizon already named in 71:1.
topics.reason: The local root handoff from {{ar:أَنذِرْ}} ({{tr:andhir}}) in 71:1 and the punishment context license advance-notice pressure without making the local noun a finite command.

topics.headline: binding speech shadows the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels that the warning binds the future by speech and makes the addressees responsible before outcome.
topics.reason: The vow branch belongs to the same n-dh-r family, but local context selects warning and advance notice, so vow remains narrowed root pressure.

topics.headline: fronted recipient phrase routes the role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters the warning role as for you before the role noun itself lands.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) as a complement of {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}).

topics.headline: warning is bound to clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees accountability tied to intelligible notice because the warning noun and clarity adjective form one agreed pair.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) the adjective of {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}), and the supplied formula evidence gives 11:25 for the same warning-clarity phrase.

topics.headline: later warner question has an early answer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see 71:2 place a clear warner before the people, so the question of 67:8 is answered by narrative evidence rather than left abstract.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows supply 11:25 for the Noah formula and 67:8 for the later question about whether a warner came.

topics.headline: imperative task becomes assumed identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the n-dh-r root cross from the command to warn in 71:1 into the self-description a warner in 71:2.
topics.reason: The same root appears as the prior imperative {{ar:أَنذِرْ}} ({{tr:andhir}}) and then as the predicate noun {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}).

topics.headline: sound fuses warning to clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the warning noun and clarity adjective land as a joined predicate through matched endings and tanwīn assimilation.
topics.reason: The local forms are adjacent indefinite nominatives, and QAC notes assimilation from the tanwīn before {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}).

words.gloss_range: Form IV active participle qualifying the warning role as clear and clarifying
words.root_gloss_range: separation, distinctness, clarity, explanation, making plain, evidentiary indication; local form selects active clarifying quality attached to the warning role

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the warning role modified by the clarity participle
speech verb that opens the utterance closed by the clarity adjective

words.prose: {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) closes the ayah by making clarity the defining quality of the warning role. It agrees with {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) as a nominative indefinite adjective, so clarity is not a separate title or second predicate; it belongs to the warning itself. The b-y-n family moves from separation to explanation, and the Form IV active participle makes that clarity active: the warning separates danger from confusion and discloses what the people must distinguish. The proof-field remains narrowed as supporting pressure, not a new local noun, but it strengthens the sense that the warning leaves no excuse of indistinction. As the final word, {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) seals the speech opened by {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}), completes the warning-clarity formula attested at 11:25, and lands with nasal opening, long ī, and the paired -un cadence that bind alarm and clarification into one delivered predicate rather than a ruptured ending.

topics.headline: clarity belongs to the warning role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees clarity as a property of Nuh's warning role, not as a detached second assertion.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) as the agreeing adjective of {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}).

topics.headline: separation imagery becomes intelligibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader understands clarity as a dividing act that separates warning from confusion and danger from false confidence.
topics.reason: The b-y-n root family licenses separation-to-clarity pressure, while local form selects an active participial quality rather than a noun of separation.

topics.headline: proof-field strengthens no-excuse clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the warning as intelligible enough to separate claim from excuse, while the local word remains the clarifying adjective.
topics.reason: The bayyina proof-field is related in the b-y-n family, but the local surface is {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}), not a proof noun.

topics.headline: manifest and making plain both fit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warning role is visible and actively clarifies danger rather than merely being present.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a Form IV active participle, and the CRITICAL rows correctly preserve both clear and making-clear force.

topics.headline: participial quality stays attached to the warner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees clarification attached to the warning role itself rather than abstracted into a separate explanation product.
topics.reason: The local form is an agreeing active participle, not a standalone abstract noun.

topics.headline: Noah formula closes with clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the warning as part of the Noah formula in 11:25, with clarity consistently paired to alarm.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows cite 11:25 for the same warning-clarity predicate.

topics.headline: dominant participle packages clarity as standing quality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the local adjective as part of a broader Quranic habit of expressing clarity as a standing active quality.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles show many b-y-n active-participle instances, and local syntax uses that form as an adjective.

topics.headline: final word makes clarity the landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears clarity as the takeaway quality where the ayah's speech act lands.
topics.reason: {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) is the final word of the ayah and completes the nominal predicate.

topics.headline: speech opened by saying closes in disclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the utterance opened by {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) to the disclosure named by its final adjective.
topics.reason: The local clause runs from a speech verb to a b-y-n clarity participle, and the supplied co-occurrence row supports that speech-disclosure connection.

topics.headline: paired sound binds alarm and clarification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second -un ending complete a balanced cadence that joins warning and clarity as one delivered predicate.
topics.reason: {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}) and {{ar:مُّبِينٌ}} ({{tr:mubīnun}}) are adjacent indefinite nominatives with a paired ending.

topics.headline: root, form, and sound converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees final clarity as semantic, formal, and acoustic at once: separation imagery, active disclosure, and paired cadence converge.
topics.reason: The convergence row accurately gathers b-y-n separation pressure, Form IV active participle force, and the paired cadence with {{ar:نَذِيرٌ}} ({{tr:nadhīrun}}).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قال, يا قوم, نذير, and مبين form an addressed self-identification.
baseline_models.mechanism: An utterance is projected toward a concrete social group, identifies the speaker as an awakener to danger, and discloses enough meaning for caution to become possible.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the outward verbal act by which the warning becomes public.
A group of people supplies the bounded human audience addressed as one community.
A warning that awakens fear and caution supplies the declared function of the speaker.
Disclosing meaning by expression or sign makes intelligible disclosure the warning's operating mode.

changed_reading.before: The clause is a bare statement that the speaker is a warner.
changed_reading.after: The clause performs a public intervention: voiced disclosure reaches a named community so that danger can be recognized and caution can begin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive يا قوم and beneficiary لكم frame the warning as directed from within a relationship.
baseline_models.mechanism: The address can carry a stance of standing over or for the community in care; the warning is therefore protective concern enacted through speech, not merely hostile prediction.

activation_trace.role: Earnest concern for something colors the act of saying as devoted care for the addressees.
Care, guardianship, and preservation supply a protective resonance to addressing 'my people.'
Fear-awakening warning becomes the means by which protective concern attempts to preserve the group.

changed_reading.before: My people identifies only who is being warned.
changed_reading.after: My people and for you claim an internal bond: the speaker stands for the community by exposing danger on its behalf.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate نذير مبين joins warning to the separation and disclosure range of ب ي ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clarity does more than improve wording: it makes a distinction visible, separating a danger-bearing course from the caution the warning invites.

activation_trace.role: The fear-awakening warning supplies the danger around which a consequential distinction is drawn.
Separation and parting supply the warning's boundary-making force between possible courses.
Appearance and becoming clear make that boundary perceptible rather than hidden.

changed_reading.before: Clear means that the warning is easy to understand.
changed_reading.after: Clear also names an act of distinction: the warning exposes a boundary before its opposed outcomes are reached.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding commission places the warning in a narrowing interval: it is dispatched before an approaching punishment, so the speaker functions as an advance intervention rather than a timeless describer.

activation_trace.role: Fear-awakening warning is the focus role now positioned inside a temporal rescue interval.
Becoming clear makes the danger present to awareness before it becomes present as an event.
Sending and dispatch supply the commissioned launch of the warning toward the people.
Precedence or approach supplies the before-position in which warning can still alter response.
Coming and arrival give the threatened event directional motion toward the audience.
Punitive pain identifies the approaching harm whose arrival the advance warning seeks to precede.

structural_cues: 71:1 explicitly commissions Noah, repeats قوم and نذر, and orders warning before arrival.
The focus self-identification immediately follows that temporal command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: sending, before, coming, and painful punishment are explicit. Reader arrow: the dispatched message acts as a temporal advance guard that preserves a response interval. Live alternative: sending may establish authorization without making temporal interception the main image.

changed_reading.before: I am a clear warner names a stable office.
changed_reading.after: I am a clear warner names a dispatched intervention moving ahead of harm while there is still time to respond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning opens an actionable protective corridor: self-protection and obedience lead toward covered consequences and delay, while a fixed term prevents that corridor from being mistaken for indefinite postponement.

activation_trace.role: Guardianship and preservation anchor the warning as care exercised for the addressed people.
Warning awakens caution, which becomes practical because the following verses supply a protective response.
Placing oneself in protection gives the commanded response a harm-avoiding function.
Covering sin and preserving its bearer from its effect supplies the promised protective outcome.
Delay to a later time creates a bounded interval in which the warning can benefit its hearers.
A fixed temporal limit closes the corridor and gives the warning urgency.

structural_cues: 71:3 supplies actionable imperatives rather than leaving the danger unspecified.
71:4 pairs forgiveness and delay with an appointed term that cannot itself be deferred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: commands, protection, forgiveness, delay, and a fixed term are supplied. Reader arrow: these form a conditional corridor through which warning attempts preservation. Live alternative: the sequence can be read as command plus promise without importing the guardianship resonance of قوم.

changed_reading.before: The warning principally announces a threat.
changed_reading.after: The warning is a time-bounded protective offer: it specifies how the people may be shielded from the danger it announces.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated calling tests the warning across public and private channels, while ears and coverings become deliberate barriers. Clarity is therefore relocated from successful uptake to the disclosure offered despite engineered non-reception.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors clarity in an actual communicative act rather than an abstract proposition.
Disclosure by expression or sign is the focus claim whose relation to reception is being revised.
Calling and inclining by speech supplies the repeated attempt to draw the hearers toward response.
Listening and accepting what is heard identifies the receptive function actively being blocked.
A covering laid over something materializes the audience's chosen barrier to disclosure.
Public announcement and raised voice test the warning in an overt channel.
Making something manifest extends the disclosure into explicit public presentation.
Concealment in the inward or private sphere supplies the opposite register, showing that channel variation was exhausted.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 accumulates night and day, repeated attempts, open proclamation, and private address.
Flight, fingers in ears, garments, persistence, and arrogance are responses to the call rather than evidence that no call reached them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: varied channels and physical acts of blocking are explicit. Reader arrow: those acts diagnose a reception failure rather than a failure of semantic disclosure. Live alternative: the hearers may reject disputed content, so clarity need not mean they accepted the warning's premises.

changed_reading.before: A clear warning should produce understanding if repeated loudly enough.
changed_reading.after: The warning remains clear while reception is strategically closed; مبين describes offered disclosure, not guaranteed persuasion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning carries a remedy as well as an alarm: seeking protective covering is followed by dispatched rain, abundant outflow, connected increase, and rivers. The warning charts a transition from arrested harm to restored circulation.

activation_trace.role: The warning supplies the alarm whose changed reading now includes a restorative route.
Preservative care keeps the promised material flow tied to the warning's concern for the people.
Covering sin and guarding from its effect supplies the requested reversal that opens the sequence.
Sending and release give the promised sky-borne provision directed motion toward the audience.
Abundant outflow from a source supplies the material image of restored provision.
Connected increase that supports another extends restoration from rain into social and material resources.
A river cutting the ground with flowing water gives the promised restoration a durable channel.

structural_cues: 71:10-12 moves from seeking forgiveness to rain, wealth, children, gardens, and rivers.
Repeated لكم in the promised benefits echoes the focus لكم and keeps the sequence beneficiary-oriented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: forgiveness and a sequence of dispatched, abundant, extended provisions are supplied. Reader arrow: warning functions as a diagnosis with a restorative channel, not only as threat. Live alternative: the provisions may be persuasive incentives accompanying the warning rather than part of the meaning of نذير itself.

changed_reading.before: The warner points only toward impending loss.
changed_reading.after: The warner also discloses how blocked flourishing may reopen, pairing alarm with a concrete restorative prognosis.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speech turns its hearers toward visible processes: staged formation, seeing, light, human growth, return, and emergence from hiddenness. These processes become signs whose indication the speaker articulates, so clarity is distributed across word and world.

activation_trace.role: A thing's 'saying' as indication lets the spoken warning articulate what visible processes signify.
Disclosure through speech or sign permits clarity to operate through observed creation as well as words.
Successive stages and states make human formation a legible sequence rather than an isolated fact.
Seeing by eye or insight explicitly recruits observation into the warning's evidentiary mechanism.
Light and illumination supply a physical analogue for making the warning's claim perceptible.
Human growth and nurture render human origin as an observable living process.
Return after departure supplies the reversal that connects origin to promised recurrence.
Bringing something out of concealment gives final emergence the same disclosure logic as مبين.

structural_cues: 71:14-18 proceeds from human stages to seeing layered heavens, light, growth from earth, return, and emergence.
The imperative to see changes the audience from passive hearers into observers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: visible stages, light, growth, return, and emergence are supplied. Reader arrow: these phenomena act as nonverbal co-testimony whose indication Noah voices. Live alternative: they remain examples inside his speech and need not be personified as independent speakers.

changed_reading.before: The warning is clear because Noah states it clearly.
changed_reading.after: The warning is clear because his utterance interprets a world of visible, recurrent signs that also disclose its logic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The addressed قوم is not a neutral, unified audience. Wealth-backed allegiance and a rival collective saying circulate within it, turning the focus utterance into counter-speech that contests an existing social direction.

activation_trace.role: Opposition and facing off expose a conflict latent within the apparently unified address to the people.
The focus utterance becomes one voiced intervention inside a field of competing speech.
Circulating public talk supplies the rival directive that keeps communal allegiance attached to the named gods.
Accumulated wealth supplies the prestige-bearing resource around which harmful influence gathers.
Allegiance and succession supply the social transmission by which the rival direction is followed.
Straying from guidance names the directional effect of that competing speech and allegiance.

structural_cues: 71:21-24 links disobedience, following wealth and offspring, great plotting, collective speech, and the misleading of many.
The repeated قال/قالوا pattern alternates Noah's reports and the people's counter-directive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: following, wealth, rival collective speech, and misdirection are supplied. Reader arrow: prestige supports allegiance, which helps rival speech circulate as a counterpublic. Live alternative: inherited cultic loyalty, rather than wealth itself, may be the primary source of authority.

changed_reading.before: Noah speaks directly to a single audience awaiting information.
changed_reading.after: Noah intervenes in a contested speech community whose loyalties and circulating directives already steer how the warning will be heard.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later entry language produces two opposed interiors: forced entry into punishment after engulfment and voluntary entry into the speaker's house in trust. The clear warning stands before that partition as a disclosed threshold offered to the still-addressed قوم.

activation_trace.role: Warning supplies the advance notice located before the two later forms of entry.
Separation and parting supply the threshold logic that distinguishes the opposed interiors.
Drowning in water supplies the engulfing transition that removes ordinary spatial control.
Entry into an interior supplies the forced destination that follows engulfment.
The same image of entry supplies a contrasting voluntary movement into the speaker's household.
Shelter and dwelling make the second interior a place of reception rather than punishment.
Heart-settling assent supplies the disposition associated with entry into shelter.
Destruction and breaking supply the terminal contrast to sheltered, trusting entry.

structural_cues: 71:25 uses caused entry into fire, while 71:28 names one who enters Noah's house as a believer.
The focus address precedes the later differentiation of the original people into opposed relations and destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: engulfment, two entry clauses, house, belief, and destruction are supplied. Reader arrow: the repeated entry grammar forms a spatial contrast that retrospectively sharpens مبين as threshold disclosure. Live alternative: the house may mark immediate social hospitality rather than an opposed final destination, so the alignment should remain analogical.

changed_reading.before: The clear warning states a danger to the people as one group.
changed_reading.after: The clear warning is issued at a threshold before the group divides into opposed modes of entry: coerced entry into punishment and trusting entry into shelter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because نذير ordinarily activates warning, not vow; it remains anchored in the same ن ذ ر predicate and is reinforced by resolve and overt utterance. Render only as a secondary resonance in which assuming the warning role sounds like public self-obligation, never as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The emphatic إني and nominal نذير permit the declaration to sound like assumption of a binding role.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the self-identification an overt public commitment.
Resolve and rising to undertake a matter supply the assumption of duty toward the people.
Binding oneself to an otherwise non-obligatory vow supplies the exploratory self-obligation resonance.

changed_reading.before: I am a warner reports an assigned identity.
changed_reading.after: The declaration may also performatively bind the speaker to carry the warning through for his people.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and is too form-distant to gloss قال as 'made little.' It remains anchored in the actual speech verb and the clause's striking compression; downstream prose should describe only a resonance of concentrated, economical speech, explicitly noting the split-root mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قال introduces a very short identity clause whose compactness carries the entire warning office.

activation_trace.role: The dominant uttered-speech branch keeps the reading attached to an actual act of saying.
The split branch of fewness and smallness supplies an exploratory pressure toward verbal concentration.
Disclosure of meaning lets the compact utterance remain functionally sufficient rather than merely sparse.

changed_reading.before: The opening verb merely introduces reported speech.
changed_reading.after: The brief declaration can be heard as concentrated speech: very few words disclose the speaker, audience, danger-function, and communicative standard at once.

strongest_changes: The commission in 71:1 turns a stable warning office into a dispatched intervention positioned before approaching harm.
The commands, forgiveness, and bounded delay make warning a protective conditional corridor rather than a bare threat.
Repeated public and private calling plus deliberate sensory closure separate offered clarity from successful reception.
Later rival speech and allegiance reveal يا قوم as an intervention inside a contested communication order.
Visible creation and the opposed entry scenes extend مبين from verbal lucidity into evidentiary and boundary-making disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus clause is exceptionally compact, yet its four rooted anchors support several mechanisms that remain distinct: public alarm, protective care, temporal interception, contested speech, visible evidence, and threshold separation. The most productive activation came from tracking how saying and clarity interact with blocked hearing, world-signs, and later counter-speech rather than treating مبين as a static adjective.
remaining_uncertainties: The care and opposition branches of ق و م are useful relational resonances but more branch-distant than the direct people-group sense.
Creation as nonverbal co-testimony is anchored by قول-as-indication and بيان-as-sign, but the phenomena may remain examples wholly contained within Noah's spoken argument.
The restorative-flow model may describe persuasive consequences attached to warning rather than the semantic content of نذير itself.
The two-entry contrast is structurally suggestive but not explicitly juxtaposed by the packet text.
The ق ل ل outlier depends on a non-dominant split-root mapping and must never be presented as a lexical reading of قال.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The warner both reveals and separates.** **ن ذ ر B001** supplies warning that awakens caution. In **مُّبِين**, **ب ي ن B004** supplies becoming clear, **B005** disclosing meaning, and **B001** separation. The immediate nominal pairing makes clarity the warning’s mode; later public/private disclosure (71:8–9) and the final separation between believers and wrongdoers (71:28) activate the other branches. The inferred arrow is that clear disclosure produces a visible division in response. The ayah can therefore present Noah simultaneously as an elucidating warner and as one whose warning draws a boundary.

2. **“For you” makes warning a protective social office.** **ق و م B001** supplies the people-group, while **ق و م B004** supplies care, guardianship, and preservation. The dative **لَكُمْ** places the warner in relation to the group, and 71:1 locates his mission before harm arrives. The packet does not state that warning itself preserves; that causal role is the abductive move. The ayah then reads as a guardianship claim directed toward the group’s preservation, not as detached threat-reporting.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 71:8–9 expanded *mubīn* from verbal clarity into public and private disclosure, while 71:28 disclosed the eventual social boundary between believing inclusion and destructive increase. These later ayat made separation through **ب ي ن B001** more visible than it was locally.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Clarity that makes refusal legible.** **Lexical evidence:** `ب ي ن B005` (disclosing meaning by expression or sign) anchors `مُّبِينٌ`; `ء ذ ن B002` (receptive hearing) and `غ ش و B001` (covering veil) are embodied at 71:7. **Structural cue:** within 71:0-7, a disclosed warning is followed by fingers in ears and garments drawn over bodies. **Assigned role:** clarity removes lack of access as an explanation for refusal. **Abductive move:** the packet gives disclosure and channel closure; I infer that deliberate closure, rather than obscurity in the message, blocks reception. **Reading change:** `مبين` reads as a diagnostic exposure of resistance as well as a quality of speech.

2. **The warner as a protective alarm.** **Lexical evidence:** `ن ذ ر B001` anchors `نَذِير`; `و ق ي B002` at 71:3 and `غ ف ر B002` at 71:4 supply self-protection and shielding from consequence. **Structural cue:** the nominal role is immediately unpacked by commands and a promised reprieve. **Assigned role:** the warner connects danger-recognition to a practicable escape route. **Abductive move:** I infer that the adjacent commands are the response the warning is designed to elicit. **Reading change:** Noah's role is not exhausted by predicting pain; it is to activate caution before the fixed limit.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The fingers, ears, and garments at 71:7 converted `ب ي ن B005` from an abstract claim of clarity into a testable communication event. The later bodily refusal confirmed that the warning discloses both danger and the hearers' active closure of access.

baseline.text: Dedi ki: Ey halkım, ben sizin için açık bir uyarıcıyım.

findings.text: Uyarının açıklığı yalnızca anlamı görünür kılmaz; sonraki tepkilerle birlikte, karşılık verenlerle kendini kapatanlar arasındaki ayrımı da açığa çıkarır.
'Sizin için' denmesi, uyarıcılığı uzaktan tehdit bildirmekten çıkarıp zarar gelmeden önce topluluğu korumaya çalışan bir gözetme görevi haline getirir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] The Summons Reaches a Closing Horizon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A communicated danger is already in motion, while mercy opens a bounded interval before its arrival.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The warning behaves at once like an approaching assailant, a maturing liability, and an account whose allotted share returns to its bearer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Consequence returns as an allotted due
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An offense creates a due share or binding obligation; its consequence returns to the actor unless forgiveness covers it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: offense with an ominous outcome (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); trailing end of a thing (`quranic:root_000521:B002/m01`); followers attached to a leader (`quranic:root_000521:B003/m01`); allotted share, especially of punishment (`quranic:root_000521:B006/m01`); full bucket as a measured allotment (`quranic:root_000521:B007/m01`); recompense returning to its worker (`quranic:root_000209:B002/m01`); self-imposed binding vow (`quranic:root_001488:B002/m01`); wound carrying a legally due compensation (`quranic:root_001488:B003/m01`); written guarantee and surety (`quranic:root_001198:B008/m01`); appointed maturity (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); punitive affliction (`quranic:root_000994:B005/m01`); forgiveness that shields the offender from effect (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The warning acquires the structure of a due account. Sin trails an act like a tail and gathers adherent consequences like followers; it can be an allotted bucket, warning can name a voluntarily or legally binding obligation, and recompense is what comes back from an act. Surety makes the liability transferable and enforceable, while forgiveness intervenes before its return by covering both fault and punitive effect.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] The Message Changes Register Without Losing Its Aim
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: One intelligible summons is carried, repeated, exposed, and concealed across different media and times.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The message acts like a signal engineered for redundancy: carrier, voice, recurrence, visible sign, private address, and public broadcast all preserve the same directional pull.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Public exposure and secret address are complementary apertures
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The speaker alternately raises, displays, and privately deposits the same address so that no register remains unused.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: raised public utterance (`quranic:root_000269:B001/m01`); visible appearance after a barrier is removed (`quranic:root_000269:B002/m01`); imposing visibility (`quranic:root_000269:B003/m01`); disclosure after concealment (`quranic:root_001041:B001/m01`); written heading that makes a text findable (`quranic:root_001041:B002/m01`); hidden communication and confidence (`quranic:root_000697:B001/m01`); inward unvoiced saying (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); penetration into hidden affairs (`quranic:root_000697:B014/m01`); disclosure of meaning (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Publicity and secrecy are not rival topics here but two apertures into one audience. Raised voice and visual exposure address the outer field; private confidence and inward speech enter the concealed field. Even the lexical heading functions as a locating device, making the proclaimed matter hard to lose in either register.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 71:1-14] Creation Proceeds by Measure, Assembly, and Stage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A formed being emerges through prior measure, joined structure, staged transition, and sustained maturation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Human creation is materialized as tailoring, architecture, bodily support, gestation, and gradual upbringing rather than a single instantaneous event.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Development crosses successive limits and states
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A developing subject advances through repeated conditions, each with a boundary, threshold, and newly available capacity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: successive stages and conditions (`quranic:root_000955:B004/m01`); boundary reached or exceeded (`quranic:root_000955:B003/m01`); edge and surrounding precinct (`quranic:root_000955:B001/m01`); intermediate condition between poles (`quranic:root_000170:B011/m01`); temporal precedence and early phase (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`); fresh beginning not prepared in advance (`quranic:root_001198:B015/m01`); beginning of a thing (`quranic:root_000266:B014/m01`); appointed span (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); total joining of parts (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: A stage is neither a random variation nor merely a finished type. It is a bounded condition that begins, occupies an interval, and yields to another. The motifs preserve both discontinuity at thresholds and continuity of the one subject traversing them.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol büyük bir küpü ve ona dayalı kapasite ölçüsünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri hacimli bir kap ve onun ölçüsüdür; diğeri bir varlığın uzamsal olarak en üstteki parçasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

concept_gloss.text: yük kaldırma, yükselme ve yola koyulma

error_profile.preserves: Yük üstlenme, yükselme ve yolculuk için harekete geçme bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yükü kaldırma gücü ile onu fiilen taşıma anlamlarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Göğün yükselmesi veya kuşun uçuşa kalkması gibi yukarı yönlü hareket bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yük alma, ayrılma ve yolculuğa başlama aşamalarını birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yol üzerinde ilerlemeyi ve belirli bir hedefe doğru seyahat etmeyi genel olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlama durumunda buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol başlangıçtaki yüklenme ve kalkış anını anlatır; komşu kol yolculuğun kendisini ve hedefe doğru ilerlemeyi çekirdek edinir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Duygusal nedeni ve bedensel titremeyi birlikte taşıyan bütün kol için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korkunun yol açtığı kısa ve istemsiz bedensel titreme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korkuya bağlı istemsiz titreme ve silkiniş hissini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Titremenin kişiyi birden tutan belirgin bir durum olarak anlatıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Titremenin kişiyi tutan bedensel bir olay olarak sunuluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin bedensel titreme halinde dışa vurulduğu kişi bağlamlarına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Neden olunan hareketi ve nesnenin ortaya çıkan kararsız sallanmasını birlikte kapsayan temel karşılıktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sözcüğün temel olarak kadınlar dışındaki erkekler topluluğunu anlattığını, kadınların ancak ikincil biçimde kapsama girebildiğini ve insan dışı varlıklara aktarılabildiğini gösterir. Bu nedenle genel ve cinsiyetçe sınırsız bir topluluk adı olarak sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel kapsam erkekler topluluğudur; kadınların katılımı ve insan dışına aktarım ikincil kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, temel topluluk anlamını bağlı anlatımlardaki yandaş ve soy çevresi anlamından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Temelde erkeklerden oluşan insan topluluğudur; bir erkeğin yandaş ve yakın soy çevresini de anlatabilir. Kadınların topluluğa bağlı olarak kapsanması ve sözün insan dışı varlıklara aktarılması ikincildir.

facets.statement: Temel gönderge, kadınlardan ayrı düşünülen erkekler topluluğudur.
Bir erkeğin yandaşları ile yakın soy çevresi, kadınların bağlı olarak kapsanması ve insan dışına aktarım bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği erkekler topluluğudur; bir erkeğin yandaşları ve yakın soy çevresi bu kapsamda yer alır. Kadınların bağlı biçimde kapsanması ile insan dışı varlıklara aktarım ayrıca kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Erkeklerden oluşan topluluğu ve buna bağlı yandaş ya da soy çevresini birlikte karşılayan en kısa açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Erkek topluluğu çekirdeğini ve bağlı yakın çevre kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadınların ikincil kapsanmadığı temel insan topluluğu bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel cinsiyet sınırını ve topluluk anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir erkeğin yandaşları ve yakın soy çevresi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Temel kapsamı erkeklerle sınırlar; kadınları ancak bağlı biçimde içeri alır ve insan dışına aktarılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aşiret, kabile ve ortak işi bulunan topluluk türlerini cinsiyet sınırı koymadan adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırt edici yönü erkekler topluluğunu çekirdek almasıdır; komşu dal ise topluluğu aşiret, kabile veya ortak iş bağı üzerinden kurar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: القوم الرجال دون النساء؛ قوم كل رجل شيعته وعشيرته (ayn;tahdhib)؛ القوم الرجال دون النساء؛ ربما دخل النساء فيه على سبيل التبع (sihah)؛ القوم جماعة الرجال في الأصل دون النساء؛ وفي عامة القرآن أريدوا به والنساء جميعا (mufradat)؛ القوم جمع امرئ ولا يكون ذلك إلا للرجال؛ وربما استعير في غيرهم (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedeni dik konuma getirme ve dik durma çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadet sırasındaki duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde dik kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel dikilme ve dik duruşla sınırlıdır; niyet, gözetim ve yerleşme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Fiziksel dik duruş çekirdeği korunur; belirli duruş ve kök üzerinde kalma anlatımları ona bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın ya da başka bir varlığın dik konuma gelmesi veya dik durumda bulunmasıdır. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadetteki ayakta duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel duruşun özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Canlı ya da cansız bir varlık dik konuma gelir veya dik durumda bulunur.
Tek ayağa kalkış, ibadet duruşu, kökü üzerinde dik kalan bitki ve duran hayvan fiziksel çekirdeğin bağlama özgü görünümleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dikilme ve dik durma çekirdeğinde birleşir; tek bir ayağa kalkışın yanı sıra ibadet, bitki ve hayvan bağlamlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel olarak dik konuma gelme ile o konumda bulunma aşamalarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem dikilme hareketini hem de ortaya çıkan dik duruşu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitki veya başka bir varlığın kendi temeli üzerinde dik durumda kalmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Dik duruşu ve bu duruşun sürmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir kez ayağa kalkma; iki bölüm arasındaki ayakta duruş

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ayağa kalkma hareketini, tek seferlik kalkışı ve ibadet, bitki ile hayvan bağlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Betimlenen varlığın dik ve ayakta olma niteliğini daha yalın biçimde öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın ortak alanı bir varlığın dik ve ayakta bulunmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem dik konuma geçişi hem çeşitli bağlamlardaki duruşu içerir; komşu dalın kartı yalnız dik ve ayakta olma niteliğini bildirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; fiziksel dik duruşla en doğrudan örtüşen aday sınır farkıyla yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قام قياما، والقومة مرة الانتصاب، والقيام في الصلاة أو الذكر، وقيام الشجر والنبت على أصله، ووقوف الدابة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو العزم على الأمر ولا حفظ الشيء ورعايته ولا إقامة المكان
branches.source_phrase_ar: القومة ما بين الركعتين من القيام؛ قمت قياما؛ منها هامد ومنها قائم (ayn;tahdhib)؛ قام الرجل قياما؛ القومة المرة الواحدة؛ قامت الدابة وقفت (sihah)؛ قيام بالشخص إما بتسخير أو اختيار؛ ساجدا وقائما؛ تركتموها قائمة على أصولها (mufradat)؛ قام قياما والقومة المرة الواحدة إذا انتصب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir işe yönelip onu üstlenme anlamındaki kararlı niyet ve girişimi destekler. Anlam yalnız zihinsel isteme değil, işe doğru yönelme ve onu üzerine alma aşamasına da bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirli bir işe yönelip onu üstlenme yapısında geçerlidir; fiziksel ayağa kalkma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız bir işe yönelme ve o işi üstlenme yapısına bağlanır; yalın eyleme genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir işe kararlılıkla yönelmek, onu üstlenmek ve yapmaya girişmektir.

facets.statement: Kişi belirli bir işe kesin niyetle yönelir, işi üstlenir ve ona girişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, belirli bir işe yönelen kararlı niyetin o işi üstlenme ve başlatma aşamasına geçtiğini birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Niyet, yönelme ve işi üstlenme bileşenlerini tek bir yapıda karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kararlı niyeti, işe yönelmeyi ve işi üstlenmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kararın yalnız düşüncede kalmayıp belirli bir işin başlatıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üstlenme ve eyleme geçiş aşamalarını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kararı belirli bir işi üstlenme ve o işe doğru harekete geçme aşamasına taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kararı zihinde kesinleştirmeyi, tereddüdü gidermeyi ve iradeyi sağlamlaştırmayı öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirli bir işi yapmaya yönelik sağlam ve kararlı niyeti içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalda kararlı niyet işe girişle gerçekleşir; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise kararın zihinde bağlanıp kesinleştirilmesidir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; niyet ile fiilî giriş arasındaki sınırı en açık gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القيام بمعنى العزم على الشيء واعتناق الأمر والنهوض إليه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مجرد انتصاب البدن ولا القوام بمعنى العماد
branches.source_phrase_ar: قام بمعنى العزيمة؛ قام بهذا الأمر إذا اعتنقه؛ قيام عزم (maqayis)؛ القيام الذي هو العزم؛ إذا قمتم إلى الصلاة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çekirdeği bir işi, topluluğu ya da düzeni sürekli gözetmek, korumak ve yönetmektir. Aynı ifadede bir işi üstlenmeye değinen unsur önceki niyet dalıyla örtüştüğünden, burada ancak sürekli sorumluluk ve koruma doğurduğu ölçüde kullanılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek sürekli gözetim, koruma ve yönetimdir; salt işe girişme veya fiziksel duruş bu dala alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yönetici ve koruyucu adları ile belirli işi gözetme yapıları ayrıştırılır; yetersizlik anlatımı yalnız kendi sözlük biriminde verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, topluluğu veya düzeni sorumluluk üstlenerek sürekli gözetmek, korumak, yönetmek ve işler durumda tutmaktır.

facets.statement: Sorumlu kişi ya da güç, bir işi veya topluluğu sürekli gözetir, korur ve yönetir.
Her şeyi sürekli yönetip koruma ve bir düzenin ayakta kalmasını sağlama, aynı sorumluluğun en geniş uygulamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, bir işi veya topluluğu koruyup yönetme ve düzenini sürdürme sorumluluğudur. Bir işi üstlenme unsuru, yalnız bu kalıcı gözetim ilişkisine dönüştüğü ölçüde çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Koruma, yönetme, sorumluluk ve düzeni sürdürme bileşenlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli gözetim, koruma, yönetim ve sorumluluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir işin sorumluluğunu üstlenip düzenli biçimde yürütme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sorumluluk, koruma ve süreklilik bileşenlerini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: işi gözeten, koruyan ve yürüten kişi
her şeyi sürekli yöneten ve koruyan
onu taşıyamadı veya buna gücü yetmedi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözetim yanında yönetme, düzenleme ve bir işin ya da topluluğun sorumluluğunu sürekli yürütme vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koruma, bekçilik, emanet ve düzenli yoklama görevlerini yönetim zorunluluğu olmadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyi koruma, gözetme ve onunla düzenli olarak ilgilenme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal korumayı yönetim ve sürekli sorumlulukla birleştirir; komşu dal koruma ve gözetme görevini daha geniş ve yönetimden bağımsız verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; koruma ile sürekli yönetim arasındaki farkı en iyi gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القيام على الشيء أو بالأمر بمعنى الحفظ والمراعاة والمواظبة والسياسة والولاية، والقيم والقوام والقيوم
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مجرد القيام بالبدن ولا قيمة السلعة ولا القامة
branches.source_phrase_ar: قيم القوم من يسوس أمرهم ويقومهم؛ القائم في الملك ونحوه الحافظ؛ القيوم (ayn)؛ قوام أهل بيته وقيام أهل بيته؛ الذي يقيم شأنهم؛ القيوم اسم من أسماء الله (sihah)؛ قيم القوم الذي يقومهم ويسوس أمرهم؛ القائم بالأمر؛ القيوم القائم على كل شيء (tahdhib)؛ قيام للشيء هو المراعاة للشيء والحفظ له؛ قوامين لله؛ القيوم القائم الحافظ لكل شيء (mufradat)؛ قام بهذا الأمر إذا اعتنقه؛ قوام الدين والحق أي به يقوم (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi sürdürme, işler ve düzgün durumda tutma ile onun gereğini ve koşullarını eksiksiz yerine getirme anlamlarını destekler. İbadet ve kutsal kitap örnekleri çekirdeği tanımlamaz, bu genel yerine getirme işlemini özelleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyi sürdürüp gereğini yerine getirmeye bağlıdır; bir yerde kalma veya fiyat belirleme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız bir şeyi sürdürme ve onun hakkını ya da koşullarını yerine getirme yapılarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürdürmek, işler ve düzgün durumda tutmak ya da gereğini ve koşullarını eksiksiz yerine getirmektir.

facets.statement: Bir şey devam ettirilir, işler durumda tutulur veya kendisine düşen gerekler eksiksiz uygulanır.
İbadetin ve kutsal kitabın gereklerini uygulamak, genel yerine getirme işleminin özel bağlamıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi devam ettirme ve düzgün durumda tutma ile ona ait gerekleri eksiksiz yerine getirmeyi aynı işlem alanında birleştirir. İbadet ve kitap bu işlemin özel nesneleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devam ettirme, işler halde tutma ve gerekli koşulları uygulama bileşenlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sürdürme ile hakkını ve koşullarını yerine getirme işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İbadet veya kitap gibi kurallı bir alanın bütün koşullarını yerine getirme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Koşulları ve yükümlülükleri uygulama anlamını korur.

ibadetin ya da kitabın gereklerini eksiksiz uygulamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyin gereklerini ve koşullarını uygulayarak onu devam ettirme işlemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir iş, topluluk veya düzen üzerinde sürekli koruma, gözetim ve yönetim sorumluluğu taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir işin veya düzenin devamını sağlama alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gereken işlemleri yerine getirmeye, komşu dal ise işin başında sürekli gözetip yönetmeye dayanır; bu yüzden birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yerde kalma eylemini, kalınan ya da ayakta durulan yeri ve kalış zamanını destekler. Oturum ve toplanmış insanlar anlamı, yerleşme çekirdeğinden gelişmiş adlaşmış bir kullanım olarak ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek bir yerde kalma ile bunun yeri veya süresidir; oturum ve topluluk anlamı bağımlı genişlemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bir yerde kalma yapısı ile yer, zaman, oturum ve topluluk bildiren adlaşmış biçimler ayrı facetlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalmak ve orayı geçici ya da sürekli durulan yer edinmektir; ayak basılan veya kalınan yer ile kalış süresi de bu çekirdekten adlandırılır. Oturum ve bir araya gelmiş topluluk anlamı bunun daha uzak uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi bir yerde kalır; kalınan yer, ayak basılan yer veya kalış süresi bu ilişki üzerinden adlandırılır.
Oturum ve o oturumda bir araya gelen insanlar, yerleşme çekirdeğinden gelişen adlaşmış uzantılardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir yerde kalma, kalınan veya ayakta durulan yer ve kalış süresi çevresinde birleşir. Oturum ve toplanmış insanlar anlamı da bu yerleşme alanına bağlı bir uzantı olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: bir yerde kalma ve kalınan yer
concept_gloss.applicability: Kalış eylemi ile bu eylemin yer ve süre adlarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kalışı, kalınan yeri ve buna bağlı zaman kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin belirli bir yerde sabitlenip orada zaman geçirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yerle ilişkiyi ve kalışın sürmesini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin belirli bir yerde kalması ve oradan ayrılmaması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalıştan yer, zaman ve oturum adları da türetir; komşu dal ise kalma ve bekleme eylemiyle sınırlıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإقامة بالمكان، والمقام أو المقامة لموضع القدمين أو موضع الإقامة أو زمانها أو المجلس والجماعة المجتمعة

branches.source_phrase_ar: أقمت بالمكان إقامة ومقاما؛ المقام موضع القدمين؛ المقام والمقامة الموضع الذي تقيم فيه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ المقامة الإقامة؛ المقامة المجلس والجماعة من الناس؛ المقام موضع القيام أو الإقامة (sihah)؛ المقام يكون مصدرا واسم مكان القيام وزمانه؛ المقامة الإقامة؛ لا مقام لكم أي لا مستقر لكم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişi veya şeyin başka birinin ya da başka bir şeyin yerini alması, onun adına iş görmesi ve işlevini üstlenmesi çekirdeğini doğrudan destekler. Değer kavramıyla kurulan köken açıklaması da bu yerini tutma ilişkisine dayanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, başkasının yerini ve işlevini üstlenme ilişkisidir; yalnız aynı yerde bulunmayı anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız birinin veya bir şeyin başkasının yerini tutması yapısına bağlıdır; yalın duruş anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyin başka birinin ya da başka bir şeyin yerini alması, onun adına iş görmesi veya işlevini üstlenmesidir.

facets.statement: Yeni katılımcı öncekinin yerini alır ve onun görevini ya da işlevini üstlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir kişi ya da şeyin diğerinin yerine konması ve onun işlevini üstlenmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir; değer açıklaması da bir şeyin karşılığının onun yerini tutmasına bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer değiştirme ile görev veya işlev üstlenmeyi birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yerine geçme, adına iş görme ve işlev üstlenme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişi adına görev yaptığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel yer değiştirme ve görev üstlenme ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onun yerine geçti veya adına görev yaptı

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle bir kişinin başka biri adına belirli bir işte görev yapmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin başkasının yerinde bulunup onun adına iş görmesini içerir.
